capabilities.why: Pre-execution command safety hooks intercept unauthorized shell commands, unapproved tool calls, and path traversal attempts in the control plane before instructions ever reach the execution guest, providing deterministic defense-in-depth.
capabilities.name: Pre-Execution Security Policy Hooks and Canary Masking

capabilities.why: Warm guest microVM and scratch filesystem retention across Step 7 failure enables graceful error recovery without repeating earlier side effects or incurring redundant VM boot-to-ready latency penalties.
capabilities.name: Warm Guest Retention and Non-Duplicative Recovery Across Step 7 Faults

capabilities.why: Outbound egress evaluation restricts data exfiltration to approved local endpoints, ensuring canary tokens and arbitrary network sockets are intercepted before escaping the execution environment.
capabilities.name: Outbound Exfiltration Egress Filtering and Mock Sink Interception

capabilities.why: Local checkpoint state preservation enables rollback before risky operations. Hypervisor-level snapshot creation remains unverified on Celesto Cloud 0.1.8 and is documented as an honest provider limitation.
capabilities.name: State Checkpoint Preservation and Explicit Hypervisor Rollback Boundary
